intro.markdown:
The pattern I've been noticing in `cc-hands` is that it stopped being a voice project a week ago. Nothing new teaches it to listen, nothing new picks a model. The branch names say install, app, docs, monetization — and the diffs underneath are shell scripts, permission prompts, keychain handling, launchd plists. A voice-for-Claude-Code product turning, PR by PR, into a packaging problem.

Today the shape held. The one-command installer learned to install hands' own plugin from a local marketplace rather than one on GitHub, so Claude Code's accept-this-marketplace prompt stops gating an unattended run. A setup window asks for Microphone and Input Monitoring in turn before hands runs. The app no longer takes focus on launch — `NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps:)` was pulling the person's current app forward seventy-nine times across one test run, and now it isn't. These are not voice features. They are what a shipped Mac app has to do.

In the margin, `dotfiles` grew the trust env Node and uv need behind Proxyman — six small commits, no PRs, Brandon's own machine. The week's labour has quietly skewed toward the thing closest to a release.

projects.markdown: ### [vhid](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid) **Swift · Apache-2.0 · 1★** A virtual keyboard and a virtual mouse for macOS, driven from a CLI or over MCP. Real HID devices through the pqrs DriverKit extension — no event taps, no Accessibility grant. 262 commits over the past month, 113 this week. The human-hands epic kept refining — pointer verbs take a box and press a point drawn inside it, aim held to the hand's line of travel by a Kalman update ([#158](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/158), [#163](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/163)); pointer moves vary like a hand's with overshoot and a bow drawn from the move's seed ([#159](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/159), [#164](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/164)); clicks rest, hold, and space a double-click like a hand ([#151](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/151)); typing comes in bursts with rollover ([#152](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/152), [#156](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/156)); click and key-repeat timings read the HID system's one setting ([#153](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/153)). `eyes` prints each match's box beside its centre, cut to where the system's hit test lands ([#157](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/157), [#160](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/160)); every rectangle it prints takes the `--rect` form ([#162](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/162)); a daemon whose file was replaced refuses to start a reader of another build ([#155](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/155)). ### [cc-hands](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands) **Python · 1★** Voice for Claude Code — speak to a session over a chord, hear its reply, run a brain that holds its own account on a dedicated Claude Code behind the proxy. 229 commits over the past month, 117 this week. Install one-command landed — one command takes a bare Mac to a running hands, Claude Code's first-run questions and login asked in-line, and today the plugin installs from a local marketplace in hands' own home so the accept-this-marketplace prompt stops gating an unattended run ([#273](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/273)–[#276](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/276), [#278](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/278), [#282](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/282), [#291](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/291)). `hands.app` runs hands and holds its macOS grants (gated to a live subscription), a setup window asks each permission in turn before hands runs, and the app never asks to be the active app so a launch does not take focus ([#270](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/270), [#271](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/271), [#285](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/285), [#289](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/289)). Voice learned named voiceprints with only the owner acting, and a session can be driven on a standing order ([#277](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/277), [#279](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/279), [#280](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/280)). Raw-api collapse — hands reaches its model only through the brain, keyed Anthropic and OpenAI backends gone ([#268](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/268)). ### [low-talker](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker) **Swift** Local push-to-talk dictation for macOS with a chord-selected command layer. 186 commits over the past month, 9 this week as the arc tapered. Earlier in the month the streaming arc landed — a press is decoded while the key is down, confirmed words commit while the press is open, dictation stays in the app its first words reached, streamed commits wait for settled punctuation ([#150](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/150)–[#153](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/153)); command mode leaves the code — an utterance becomes one thing, its text at the cursor ([#160](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/160)); a HUD with listening/transcribing, Open at Login, Fn/Globe as the chord ([#161](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/161)–[#168](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/168)). This week was the tail: audio under the audible floor answered as nothing said, `verbose_json` serves `avg_logprob` and `compression_ratio`, and an install from huggingface.co records the sizes the hub lists for the revision so a truncated file is fetched again instead of certified ([#169](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/169)–[#171](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/171)). ### [rich-js](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js) **TypeScript · MIT** A port of Python's Rich to TypeScript — markup, tables, trees, syntax, progress, tracebacks, Live, and an App runtime that routes focus and the pointer. 157 commits over the past month, 28 this week. The docs card epic landed — static examples became editable cards running in the browser, with output re-rendered client-side, keyboard input, file tabs, slider playgrounds, and edits reaching a running program without restarting it ([#351](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/351)–[#362](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/362)); `/playground` is the card at full width ([#356](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/356)). Byte-for-byte reconciliation with Python's Rich across progress, table, rule, pretty and effects ([#343](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/343), [#344](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/344), [#346](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/346)–[#348](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/348), [#350](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/350)). The effect catalogue — Effected, shimmer, pulse, sparkle, wheel, fade and dissolve — promoted to `src/` with a docs page, and ProgressBar's pulse animates on the library's own clock ([#338](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/338), [#340](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/340)–[#342](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/342), [#345](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/345)); site xterm.js 5.3 → `@xterm/xterm` 6 ([#349](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/349)). ### [gh-pages-multiplexer](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer) **TypeScript** GitHub Action + CLI: deploy static sites to versioned subdirectories on gh-pages with auto index page, navigation widget, and PR previews. New repo last week, 65 commits since. Concurrent deploys rebuild from the probed tip instead of rebasing, deploy concurrency is keyed per version slot, token kept out of process args and `.git/config`, publish retries bounded by a 10-minute deadline ([#1](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/1)–[#5](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/5)). The nav widget refreshes in every slot and no second switcher appears inside iframes, storage namespace per slot, PR cleanup correctness ([#6](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/6)–[#11](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/11)); slot names URL-safe by construction, sitemap percent-encoding, canonical URLs stop pointing at 404s ([#12](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/12)–[#14](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/14)); `check:dist` gate on every PR, ref-patterns match the ref name, test git identity isolated ([#15](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/15)–[#19](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/19)). ### [cc-candybar](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar) **TypeScript · MIT** Powerline statusline for Claude Code — fork of `@owloops/claude-powerline` with CLI override flags so the entire config can live in `settings.json`. 59 commits over the past month, 22 this week. A live bar on GitHub Pages replays Claude turns, and `pnpm bar:web` opens the live bar in a browser terminal you can click ([#296](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/296), [#297](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/297)). Menu work this week — every option setting is `◀ value ▶` opening a plain list, settings marked when they differ from default, the session tab gained `⎘ resume` and `↗ config`, autocompact control, and an alt theme that turns hue every three cells along a row ([#298](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/298), [#300](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/300), [#302](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/302), [#303](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/303), [#306](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/306), [#308](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/308)). The doctor checks that config is correct and the URL handler works ([#311](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/311), [#314](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/314)); a fragment's style reads through the render's theme on rich-js 0.19.0 ([#316](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/316)); a session segment shows the lit ticket being worked, its phase and epic progress ([#317](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/317)).
